strength: A new, simple card-only Offer (two cards, chance picks one) makes signalling cost the cards you need; Random wins 0.6% vs Honest 73% and endings are tense.
weakness: The anti-code design is unproven and fails at harder Fog (Code beats Honest by +12.1 at F=16), Standard is too easy (73%), and about a third of turns are dull Trims.
required_changes: Close the code channel (show only row, or restrict offered pairs to adjacent values); retest Code attack at F=12 and F=16 for gap <= 10 points
Set 2-player Standard to Fog 12 or cut Beacon bonus; Honest win rate 40-60%
Make caution pay (2 Reefs or a miss costs a Fog card) so Greedy <= Honest + 5
Give Trim an upside (draw 2 keep 1 or reveal discard); Trim share under 25% of turns
Resolve all 9 rule ambiguities and specify a physical procedure for the secret Offer shuffle
Remove or redesign the Convention tier
Run two human playtests before fixing Fog
revision_reason: Core loop and skill gap are strong and the problems have named, testable fixes; one revision is justified if the code-channel fix is retested at F=12.
